# dowel

> Composable CLI framework and stdio MCP server for Flutter and Dart. Scaffolding, code generation, transactional plugin installs, hot reload orchestration, REPL, and AI agent tool surfaces in one binary.

Pure Dart 3.4+ CLI framework. Consumed via `dart run dowel <command>`. 21 built-in commands plus a stdio MCP server for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf).

## Docs
- [Installation](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/getting-started/installation.md)
- [Quickstart](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md)
- [Command catalog](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/index.md)
- [start](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/start.md): records the session per project under `~/.dowel/sessions/<hash>/`, so two apps can be driven at once. `~/.dowel/state.json` stays as a pointer to whichever started last. Override with `--state=<path>` or `DOWEL_STATE_FILE`; commands refuse to act on another project's app.
- [plugin:install](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/plugin-install.md)
- [mcp:serve](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/mcp-serve.md)
- [make:plugin](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/make-plugin.md)
- [install](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/install.md)
- [tinker](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/tinker.md)
- [MCP overview](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/mcp/overview.md)
- [MCP setup](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/mcp/setup.md)
- [MCP tool reference](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/mcp/tool-reference.md)
- [Plugin authoring](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/plugins/authoring.md)
- [install.yaml schema](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/plugins/install-yaml.md)
- [Installer DSL](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/plugins/installer-dsl.md)
